opportunities.title: Assamese AI Video Production Training
opportunities.description: I want to master the complete, end-to-end process of producing AI-powered educational course videos in Assamese so I can serve under-privileged learners across rural Assam. I will be working only with my PC, so every step—from AI-assisted scriptwriting to final editing—must rely on free or very low-cost tools. The lessons themselves, as well as the videos I will later create, should use Assamese sprinkled with simple English terms. To start, I would like our first module to focus on “Digital literacy for daily life,” then we can branch into AI awareness and basic computer skills for students and women in village communities. I am an absolute beginner, so I need practical, hands-on guidance rather than theory. Show me how to: • Brainstorm topics and generate scripts with AI in Assamese • Create or clone an Assamese voice-over that sounds natural • Add accurate Assamese subtitles automatically • Source or generate visuals and simple motion graphics that reinforce the lesson • Edit everything entirely on my phone (for example with CapCut, KineMaster, Canva, or any better free option), then export in a format suitable for YouTube or WhatsApp distribution I prefer live screen-sharing sessions (Zoom, Meet, or similar) backed up by recorded walk-throughs and mini-assignments so I can practise and get your feedback quickly. When you reply, please include: 1. Your experience creating educational content for non-English audiences and any sample links. 2. A short, session-by-session training roadmap with estimated hours. 3. The specific free or low-cost mobile apps and AI tools you recommend. 4. Total cost for the complete training package and any milestone breakdown you suggest. With the right mentor I’ll be able to produce these Assamese digital-literacy videos independently; I’m eager to get started as soon as we agree on the plan.

opportunities.title: Branded Dotdigital Newsletter Template
opportunities.description: I need a reusable email template built directly inside Dotdigital so our comms team can share news without wrestling with layout each time. You will work from the full brand guide I’ll supply—logo, colours, fonts, plus sample emails—and translate it into a fully custom HTML template with only the core text and images left editable. Core layout • Above-the-fold headline story • A clearly marked Team Updates column • Dedicated Events panel • Space for supporting news blurbs and calls-to-action Technical requirements The template must be coded in HTML/CSS that plays nicely with Dotdigital’s EasyEditor, render flawlessly on both desktop and mobile, and pass standard Litmus-style client tests. Fonts, padding, and colour styles need to lock to our guidelines while still letting non-technical staff drop in new copy or swap images. Deliverables 1. Dotdigital-ready template file (or direct import into my workspace). 2. A short usage note or Loom walkthrough that shows exactly where each content block can be edited. If you need any additional hex values, logos, or font files, tell me and I’ll send them straight away.

opportunities.description: Necesito un video de 30 segundos generado con herramientas de inteligencia artificial. Yo ya tengo el guion de texto y los logos oficiales; también compartiré indicaciones básicas sobre la ambientación, disposición del producto y la tonalidad que debe transmitir cada plano. Lo que busco: • Estilo visual realista y cinematográfico. • El producto o servicio debe aparecer siempre en primer plano, con encuadres atractivos y transiciones fluidas. • Formatos optimizados para Instagram y Facebook (1080 × 1080 y 1080 × 1920; H.264, 30 fps). • Música de fondo libre de derechos y efectos sonoros sutiles que refuercen la narrativa. • Color grading coherente y títulos o subtítulos si es necesario, respetando mi paleta corporativa. Entrego: – Guion completo con llamadas a acción. – Archivos de logotipo en alta resolución. – Referencias visuales y notas sobre la puesta en escena. Espero un archivo final listo para publicar y, si es posible, el proyecto editable por si más adelante necesito ajustes menores. Si dominas plataformas como Runway, Pika Labs o similares, menciónalo: me ayudará a evaluar tiempos y posibilidades de refinamiento.

opportunities.title: Lead Generation Expert (IT Services) who can do cold calling
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a business development professional who can consistently win fresh small- and medium-sized business accounts for our IT practice. My team already handles the delivery side—website and mobile-app development, custom software and business-process automation, plus a new range of digital invite solutions—so you can stay focused on prospecting, pitching, and closing. Here’s what I need from you: own the full sales cycle, from researching ideal prospects and crafting outreach campaigns to negotiating terms and getting signatures on new projects. You’ll have access to detailed case studies, demo builds, and direct support from our technical architects whenever scoping questions arise, but lead generation and relationship management remain in your hands. Deliverables I will measure: • A qualified pipeline that reflects steady week-to-week growth • Regular progress updates summarising activity, next steps, and revenue forecasts • Closed deals that translate into development projects for our team • Someone who is good in cold calling will be + as we need someone who can call the potential leads. If you thrive on building trust with decision-makers and have a track record of turning IT service conversations into signed engagements, let’s talk.

opportunities.title: 2026 UK TecDoc & TecRMI CSV Dump
opportunities.description: Start your reply with TECDOC2026BID so I know you're not a bot. I need a clean, up-to-date 2026 dump of both TecDoc and TecRMI data, limited strictly to the UK market. The scope covers the entire vehicle, parts, and fitment catalogue together with all available repair, service, and maintenance information. Please export the data in the standard TecDoc CSV layout: one CSV per table (articles, article_links, manufacturers, vehicles, etc.) and place each parts-brand sub-set in its own folder so I can import it directly into our existing pipeline. Follow the same structure for the TecRMI tables so repair content lines up against the TecDoc vehicle IDs. Deliverables • Zipped archive containing the full set of 2026 CSV files, organised exactly as described • A short README that lists each table name and the field count so I can automate the integrity check The files will be parsed automatically, so stick to the official column order, field names, and encodings supplied by TecAlliance. PLEASE NOTE: You will need to provide the data for me. I do not hold credentials.

opportunities.title: Premium Headwear Branding & Mockups
opportunities.description: Premium Headwear Brand Identity, Logo Refinement & Product Mockups Project Type: Fixed Price Budget: £600 GBP Duration: Approximately 3–4 weeks Project Type: Private Project — Selected Freelancer Project Overview We are developing a premium minimalist headwear brand, starting with one signature Docker Hat model. We require a professional graphic and brand identity designer to refine our existing logo, create premium product mockups, and develop woven brand and care label artwork. The designer will collaborate with our separate headwear product designer, who will supply three approved subtle variations of the same signature Docker Hat, featuring different colours, materials and design details. Our brand direction is minimalist, premium, timeless, modern and understated. Scope 1 — Logo Design & Brand Identity Use our existing approved logo as the reference and foundation. Conduct initial sketch exploration. Present two curated logo concepts, each with primary and secondary treatments (four concept visuals total). Develop one approved primary and one secondary logo treatment. Provide colour and monochrome variations. Include one optional live logo refinement session of up to 60 minutes after initial concept approval, counting within the included revision rounds. Supply SVG, PDF, transparent PNG and editable vector source files. Provide appropriate commercial font and asset licensing documentation. Include two consolidated revision rounds. All final artwork requires client approval. Scope 2 — Woven Brand Label & Care Label Design one woven brand label and one care label artwork set. Provide placement guidance. Coordinate technical specifications, dimensions and placement with our headwear product designer and manufacturer. Supply final approved label artwork suitable for production. Include two consolidated revision rounds. Scope 3 — Premium Docker Hat Mockups Create digital mockups for three approved subtle variations of one signature Docker Hat, supplied by our product designer. Each variation will have one approved colourway and five presentation views: Front view Side view Back view Model/lifestyle view Store/e-commerce presentation view Total: 15 high-resolution digital mockup visuals. Deliverables: High-resolution JPG/PNG images. PDF presentation. Accurate representation of approved designs, colours, materials and logo placement. Consistent premium visual presentation. Two consolidated revision rounds. Editable mockup source files, custom 3D modelling and physical photography are excluded. Timeline & Coordination The project is expected to take approximately 3–4 weeks: Week 1: Logo exploration and refinement. Week 2: Hat and label design coordination. Week 3: Creation and finalisation of 15 digital mockups. Week 4: Final review, written approval and file delivery. The timeline depends on timely feedback and receipt of approved product designs. Intellectual Property & Confidentiality All approved final original artwork and transferable commercial rights will be assigned exclusively to the client upon full payment. The designer must ensure the work is original and does not infringe third-party intellectual property rights. No generative AI artwork is permitted. Any commercial fonts or third-party assets must be appropriately licensed. All project information, designs and unreleased brand materials must remain confidential. Physical hat design, technical packs, sampling and manufacturing are managed separately. Payment & Milestones This is a fixed-price project managed through Freelancer.com. Milestone 1 — 50% (£300): Funded before work begins. Milestone 2 — 50% (£300): Released only after all agreed final design files have been delivered, reviewed, checked and formally approved by the client. Payment, intellectual property ownership and final deliverables are subject to the signed bilingual freelance services agreement. Any additional services or charges must be agreed in writing before proceeding.

opportunities.title: Cinematic Sci-Fi Artist Wanted
opportunities.description: Cinematic Sci-Fi Artist Wanted — Three High-Resolution Cosmic Illustrations for a Book I have developed a vast Earth-centred cosmic structure and established its visual appearance, composition, scale, and progression through a set of detailed reference images. I'm looking for an accomplished sci-fi concept artist, cosmic environment illustrator, or cinematic digital artist to transform these references into three exceptionally polished, realistic, book-ready illustrations. This is not a redesign project. The existing references establish the visual concept, and the objective is to preserve that design while significantly elevating the cinematic realism, lighting, material quality, and fine detail. All three illustrations depict the same structure from different viewpoints, including a complete overhead view looking down toward Earth's Arctic region. Visual consistency is therefore essential. The underlying geometry, proportions, and distinctive structural characteristics must remain consistent across all three images. You may work in 2D digital painting, 3D rendering, or a hybrid workflow. I'm interested in the quality of the finished artwork rather than requiring any particular software or technique. I will provide the reference images, an explanation of the intended progression, and feedback throughout the project. Deliverables Three finished, print-ready illustrations, minimum 6K resolution on the longest side, suitable for reproduction at 300 dpi. High-quality RGB masters in a lossless format, with CMYK versions to be prepared if required once the printer's colour specifications are confirmed. Layered working files or editable source files where applicable. A brief explanation of the workflow and any considerations relevant to final print preparation. Acceptance Criteria Each illustration must faithfully preserve the established visual concept and structural details shown in the supplied references while achieving a significantly more polished, cinematic and visually believable finish. The three illustrations must remain consistent representations of the same underlying structure when viewed side-by-side. I would like to review preliminary work at agreed milestones so that composition and structural consistency can be approved before final detailing. Timeline Ideally within four weeks, although I'm open to discussing a realistic schedule with the right artist. Please include relevant portfolio examples, your proposed approach, estimated timeframe, and total fixed-price quotation for the three illustrations. I'm particularly interested in artists with portfolios demonstrating exceptional cinematic environments, cosmic imagery, sophisticated lighting, and detailed realistic rendering.

opportunities.title: Full Twilio Account & IVR Setup
opportunities.description: I need a Twilio account created, configured, and ready for hand-off to my in-house developer. The account will hold two numbers: a main line with an IVR and a direct line for the receptionist. Voice flow • When someone calls the main number they should hear a brief greeting, then an IVR menu that lets them press a key for Reception, leave a voicemail, or speak to a team member. • Call transfers must work smoothly, and I need the ability to pull additional parties onto the same call for ad-hoc conferences. Messaging • SMS must be enabled on both numbers, with my website fully A2P-compliant and approved so users can text us directly from the site. • Group texts and replies to group threads have to function as naturally as one-to-one messages. • WhatsApp Business messaging is required for both inbound and outbound chats, participation in group chats, and posting status updates. Other essentials • Please secure the account, apply best-practice configuration, and document any SID, Auth Token, and webhook URLs my developer will need for CRM integration. • I will need an estimate of Twilio’s recurring monthly cost based on typical U.S. voice minutes, domestic SMS, and WhatsApp usage so I can budget correctly. • Let me know your timeline to complete the setup and your fee (fixed or milestone-based). Deliverables (for acceptance): 1. Twilio account with two active numbers. 2. IVR flow matching the menu above, tested end-to-end. 3. Working SMS/MMS with A2P registration approved. 4. Conference calling and group texting verified. 5. WhatsApp Business messaging enabled and tested. 6. Brief hand-over document covering configuration details and any API endpoints. If anything in this brief needs clarification, feel free to ask; otherwise, include your plan, timeline, and cost breakdown in your bid.

opportunities.title: Android WhatsApp Calling Tutor
opportunities.description: I’m completely new to smartphones and need a patient tutor who can guide me, in very simple Hindi, through the absolute basics of using an Android phone. My first priority is mastering everyday communication: setting up WhatsApp, making voice calls, and starting video calls with friends and family. Here’s what I’d like from you: • Live or recorded screen-share sessions (Zoom, Google Meet, or any tool you prefer) that walk me step by step from turning the phone on, connecting to Wi-Fi, installing/configuring WhatsApp, to confidently placing voice and video calls. • Clear explanations of why each step matters, so I don’t just memorise taps but actually understand the flow. • Homework tasks after every lesson so I can practise between sessions, plus quick feedback on where I’m going wrong. • A short Hindi cheat-sheet (PDF or Word) summarising all key steps, icons, and settings we cover. Once I’m comfortable with WhatsApp calling, I may want to expand into other apps, so your flexibility for follow-up lessons would be a bonus. If you enjoy teaching absolute beginners and can keep things friendly, jargon-free, and practical, I’d love to work with you.

opportunities.title: Build NinjaTrader 8 Trading Bot -- 2
opportunities.description: Hiring Experienced NinjaTrader 8 Algorithmic Trading Bot Developer I am looking for an experienced algorithmic trading developer to build a fully automated trading bot for NinjaTrader 8 using C# and NinjaScript. The primary focus will be trading Nasdaq futures (NQ and MNQ), with the possibility of expanding to other futures markets and supported stock instruments. The goal is to develop a professional automated trading system based on price action, moving averages, market structure, and technical trading strategies. Project Requirements 1. Automated Trading System * Fully automated trade execution. * Automated buy and sell signals. * Long and short trading capabilities. * Customizable trading parameters. * Ability to enable or disable automated execution. 2. Technical Analysis * Multiple moving average strategies. * Price action and candlestick pattern recognition. * Support and resistance identification. * Trend confirmation across multiple timeframes. * Breakout and pullback detection. * Volume analysis. 3. Multi-Timeframe Analysis * 2-minute chart for entries. * 5-minute and 15-minute confirmation. * 1-hour timeframe for overall market direction. 4. Risk Management * Automatic stop-loss and take-profit orders. * Trailing stop functionality. * Configurable risk-to-reward ratios. * Maximum daily loss limits. * Maximum number of trades per day. * Position sizing controls. 5. Strategy Testing * Historical backtesting. * Strategy optimization. * Performance reporting. * Simulation and paper trading. * Walk-forward testing to reduce overfitting. 6. Platform Integration * Full compatibility with NinjaTrader 8. * NinjaScript/C# source code. * Easy installation and configuration. * Ability to modify strategy settings. * Documentation and technical support. Developer Qualifications Must have proven experience developing automated trading strategies for NinjaTrader 8. Experience with Nasdaq futures, algorithmic trading, price action strategies, and risk management is strongly preferred. Please provide: 1. Examples of NinjaTrader bots you have developed. 2. Your experience with NinjaScript and C#. 3. Whether you can build a fully automated strategy from custom trading rules. 4. Your estimated development timeline. 5. Your project pricing. 6. Whether you provide full source code ownership. 7. Whether you offer ongoing support and updates. I am looking for a reliable developer interested in building a professional, customizable algorithmic trading system. The complete trading strategy and specific entry/exit conditions will be shared privately after selecting a qualified developer and signing a confidentiality agreement (NDA).

The primary focus will be trading Nasdaq futures (NQ and MNQ), with the possibility of expanding to other futures markets and supported stock instruments. The goal is to develop a professional automated trading system based on price action, moving averages, market structure, and technical trading strategies. Project Requirements 1. Automated Trading System * Fully automated trade execution. * Automated buy and sell signals. * Long and short trading capabilities. * Customizable trading parameters. * Ability to enable or disable automated execution. 2. Technical Analysis * Multiple moving average strategies. * Price action and candlestick pattern recognition. * Support and resistance identification. * Trend confirmation across multiple timeframes. * Breakout and pullback detection. * Volume analysis. 3. Multi-Timeframe Analysis * 2-minute chart for entries. * 5-minute and 15-minute confirmation. * 1-hour timeframe for overall market direction. 4. Risk Management * Automatic stop-loss and take-profit orders. * Trailing stop functionality. * Configurable risk-to-reward ratios. * Maximum daily loss limits. * Maximum number of trades per day. * Position sizing controls. 5. Strategy Testing * Historical backtesting. * Strategy optimization. * Performance reporting. * Simulation and paper trading. * Walk-forward testing to reduce overfitting. 6. Platform Integration * Full compatibility with NinjaTrader 8. * NinjaScript/C# source code. * Easy installation and configuration. * Ability to modify strategy settings. * Documentation and technical support. Developer Qualifications Must have proven experience developing automated trading strategies for NinjaTrader 8. Experience with Nasdaq futures, algorithmic trading, price action strategies, and risk management is strongly preferred. Please provide: 1. Examples of NinjaTrader bots you have developed. 2. Your experience with NinjaScript and C#. 3. Whether you can build a fully automated strategy from custom trading rules. 4. Your estimated development timeline. 5. Your project pricing. 6. Whether you provide full source code ownership. 7. Whether you offer ongoing support and updates. I am looking for a reliable developer interested in building a professional, customizable algorithmic trading system. The complete trading strategy and specific entry/exit conditions will be shared privately after selecting a qualified developer and signing a confidentiality agreement (NDA)."

opportunities.title: REEL Animation Manga with Avatar AI
opportunities.description: Je souhaite transformer mon script existant en une courte vidéo de style manga (2 minutes maximum) où je suis le héros principal. Style visuel : réaliste, inspiré des grands films d’animation japonais — couleurs riches, éclairages soignés, mouvements fluides. Éléments fournis • Le scénario complet, déjà finalisé. • Des photos de moi pour créer un avatar fidèle. Éléments à créer • Un couple d’une quarantaine d’années, réaliste mais entièrement imaginé. • Tous les décors et animations correspondant aux scènes du script. • Une narration voix off (aucun dialogue à l’écran). Contraintes techniques • Durée totale : 120 secondes maximum. • Aucune bulle de texte ; la narration doit porter l’histoire. • Export final en 1080p (MP4 ou MOV) prêt pour diffusion en ligne en format portrait ou paysage (selon le mieux adapté) • Pistes audio séparées (voix off + musique/FX) pour d’éventuels ajustements. Processus attendu 1. Esquisses des personnages et décors pour validation rapide. 2. Storyboard simplifié afin de confirmer le rythme et les cadrages. 3. Animation complète, intégration de la voix off et mixage sonore. 4. Une révision finale incluse pour peaufiner couleurs ou timings. Si vous maîtrisez l’animation 2D/3D hybride, Toon Boom, Blender ou un pipeline équivalent et que vous êtes à l’aise avec la narration cinématique, j’ai hâte de découvrir votre approche et votre portfolio.

opportunities.title: Secure Windows Endpoint DLP Deployment
opportunities.description: Project Title Self-Hosted Employee Monitoring, Source-Code Protection and USB Device Control System Project Overview I am looking for an experienced Windows endpoint security and system administration freelancer to deploy a centrally managed, self-hosted employee monitoring and data-loss prevention system. The system will protect confidential source code and project files across all company Windows PCs. The management server must be hosted on my VPS. I will provide the VPS specifications and access details to the selected freelancer through a secure method. The freelancer must complete the deployment remotely. An on-site visit will not be possible. I prefer open-source software and self-hosted solutions. 1. Centralised Management Dashboard Deploy and configure a central dashboard accessible only to authorised administrators. The dashboard should provide: * Status of all managed computers. * Online/offline status and last communication time. * Installed applications and relevant system changes. * Security events and suspicious activity. * USB device connection and disconnection history. * Alerts for attempted policy violations. * Searchable logs with timestamps and computer/user identification. The system must continue collecting and retaining events when I am not actively monitoring the dashboard. 2. USB Device Allowlisting — Mandatory This is a critical requirement. All unauthorised USB storage devices must be blocked by default. Only explicitly approved devices may be used. Required functionality: * Block unapproved USB storage devices. * Allow specifically approved USB devices. * Identify approved devices using hardware identifiers and serial numbers where reliably supported. * Prevent employees from bypassing restrictions through ordinary user accounts. * Record connection attempts involving unauthorised devices where supported. * Alert the administrator when a prohibited device is detected or an access attempt is blocked. * Provide an administrator-controlled method to approve additional devices. * Apply policies consistently across all managed computers. Restrictions must survive computer restarts and ordinary Windows updates. The freelancer must test the policy using both authorised and unauthorised USB storage devices. USB restrictions must not unnecessarily disable keyboards, mice or other essential peripherals. The implementation must distinguish between blocking USB storage access and blocking device installation. It must enforce the intended storage restrictions without accidentally disabling unrelated devices. 3. Source-Code Protection Implement practical controls to reduce the risk of employees transferring confidential source code outside the organisation. Where technically supported, the system should: * Monitor access to designated confidential project directories. * Record relevant file modifications and configured file-system events. * Restrict unauthorised transfers to removable storage. * Support restrictions on uploads to unauthorised websites and cloud-storage services. * Support appropriate restrictions on personal email and file-sharing applications. * Record relevant security events and blocked transfer attempts. * Detect attempts to disable or tamper with security software. Monitoring alone is insufficient. The solution must include actual enforcement mechanisms for the transfer channels it claims to block. The freelancer must clearly explain which controls actively prevent transfers and which merely generate alerts. Known limitations involving encrypted applications or unsupported transfer methods must be documented. 4. Remote Deployment and USB Policy Enforcement Because the freelancer cannot visit the office, deployment must be completed remotely. Required deliverables: 1. Configure the central server on my VPS. 2. Install and configure the required management software. 3. Provide a Windows installation package or deployment script for the endpoint agent, where supported. 4. Provide a PowerShell script, Group Policy configuration or equivalent supported configuration for USB restrictions. 5. Document the exact steps required to install the endpoint agent on each computer. 6. Provide a repeatable procedure to apply USB policies across all managed computers. 7. Document how to approve new USB devices and revoke their approval. 8. Provide a recovery procedure if a policy accidentally blocks an authorised device. 9. Verify that endpoint agents reconnect to the management server after restarts or temporary network interruptions. Scripts must use supported enforcement mechanisms and be suitable for legitimate administration of company-owned computers. Any security policy that could interrupt normal operations must first be tested on a designated computer before wider deployment. 5. Server and Network Security The freelancer must: * Assess the VPS specifications before selecting the software. * Recommend a suitable operating system and resource allocation. * Configure encrypted communications between endpoints and the server. * Restrict administrative dashboard access. * Configure strong administrator authentication. * Avoid exposing unnecessary management ports to the public internet. * Configure appropriate log retention and backups. * Document firewall rules and required network connectivity. I will provide the VPS details after selecting the freelancer. 6. Documentation and Handover The freelancer must provide: * Complete installation instructions. * A list of installed components and their purposes. * Configuration files and custom scripts created for the project. * Instructions for managing all endpoints. * USB allowlisting and revocation instructions. * Troubleshooting and recovery instructions. * Backup and restoration instructions. * A list of software licences and recurring costs. * A final report identifying implemented controls and known limitations. All administrator accounts, credentials, configuration files and custom scripts must be handed over to me. The freelancer must not retain unauthorised access to the VPS or office computers after completion. 7. Acceptance Testing Project completion depends on successfully demonstrating that: 1. All managed computers appear in the central dashboard. 2. Endpoint agents reconnect after computer restarts. 3. Unauthorised USB storage devices are blocked. 4. Authorised USB storage devices function according to the configured policy. 5. Relevant USB events are recorded. 6. The administrator can approve and revoke USB devices. 7. Relevant security events appear in the dashboard. 8. Attempts to tamper with endpoint protection are detected where supported. 9. Administrative access is properly secured. 10. Installation and recovery instructions are complete and reproducible. The freelancer must demonstrate the results remotely and provide evidence of the acceptance tests. 8. Freelancer Qualifications Applicants should have practical experience with: * Windows endpoint security and administration. * Windows device-control policies. * PowerShell automation. * Microsoft Defender device control or equivalent USB-control products. * Wazuh or comparable endpoint monitoring systems. * Data-loss prevention and source-code protection. * Linux VPS administration. * Firewall configuration and secure remote management. 9. Proposal Requirements Please include the following in your proposal: 1. Your recommended software stack and reasons for selecting it. 2. Which components will run on my VPS and which will run on the Windows computers. 3. How you will enforce USB device allowlisting. 4. How you will block unauthorised source-code transfers. 5. Which requirements can be met using open-source software. 6. Which features require commercial licences or additional software. 7. Your recommended VPS specifications. 8. Your fixed project cost and estimated completion time. 9. Any limitations or prerequisites that need clarification before deployment. Please do not propose a monitoring-only solution that cannot enforce the required USB restrictions. The project will be considered complete only after deployment, testing and documentation.

Restrictions must survive computer restarts and ordinary Windows updates. The freelancer must test the policy using both authorised and unauthorised USB storage devices. USB restrictions must not unnecessarily disable keyboards, mice or other essential peripherals. The implementation must distinguish between blocking USB storage access and blocking device installation. It must enforce the intended storage restrictions without accidentally disabling unrelated devices. 3. Source-Code Protection Implement practical controls to reduce the risk of employees transferring confidential source code outside the organisation. Where technically supported, the system should: * Monitor access to designated confidential project directories. * Record relevant file modifications and configured file-system events. * Restrict unauthorised transfers to removable storage. * Support restrictions on uploads to unauthorised websites and cloud-storage services. * Support appropriate restrictions on personal email and file-sharing applications. * Record relevant security events and blocked transfer attempts. * Detect attempts to disable or tamper with security software. Monitoring alone is insufficient. The solution must include actual enforcement mechanisms for the transfer channels it claims to block. The freelancer must clearly explain which controls actively prevent transfers and which merely generate alerts. Known limitations involving encrypted applications or unsupported transfer methods must be documented. 4. Remote Deployment and USB Policy Enforcement Because the freelancer cannot visit the office, deployment must be completed remotely. Required deliverables: 1. Configure the central server on my VPS. 2. Install and configure the required management software. 3. Provide a Windows installation package or deployment script for the endpoint agent, where supported. 4. Provide a PowerShell script, Group Policy configuration or equivalent supported configuration for USB restrictions. 5. Document the exact steps required to install the endpoint agent on each computer. 6. Provide a repeatable procedure to apply USB policies across all managed computers. 7. Document how to approve new USB devices and revoke their approval. 8. Provide a recovery procedure if a policy accidentally blocks an authorised device. 9. Verify that endpoint agents reconnect to the management server after restarts or temporary network interruptions. Scripts must use supported enforcement mechanisms and be suitable for legitimate administration of company-owned computers. Any security policy that could interrupt normal operations must first be tested on a designated computer before wider deployment. 5. Server and Network Security The freelancer must: * Assess the VPS specifications before selecting the software. * Recommend a suitable operating system and resource allocation. * Configure encrypted communications between endpoints and the server. * Restrict administrative dashboard access. * Configure strong administrator authentication. * Avoid exposing unnecessary management ports to the public internet. * Configure appropriate log retention and backups. * Document firewall rules and required network connectivity. All managed computers appear in the central dashboard. 2. Endpoint agents reconnect after computer restarts. 3. Unauthorised USB storage devices are blocked. 4. Authorised USB storage devices function according to the configured policy. 5. Relevant USB events are recorded. 6. The administrator can approve and revoke USB devices. 7. Relevant security events appear in the dashboard. 8. Attempts to tamper with endpoint protection are detected where supported. 9. Administrative access is properly secured. 10. Installation and recovery instructions are complete and reproducible. The freelancer must demonstrate the results remotely and provide evidence of the acceptance tests. 8. Freelancer Qualifications Applicants should have practical experience with: * Windows endpoint security and administration. * Windows device-control policies. * PowerShell automation. * Microsoft Defender device control or equivalent USB-control products. * Wazuh or comparable endpoint monitoring systems. * Data-loss prevention and source-code protection. * Linux VPS administration. * Firewall configuration and secure remote management. 9. Proposal Requirements Please include the following in your proposal: 1. Your recommended software stack and reasons for selecting it. 2. Which components will run on my VPS and which will run on the Windows computers. 3. How you will enforce USB device allowlisting. 4. How you will block unauthorised source-code transfers. 5. Which requirements can be met using open-source software. 6. Which features require commercial licences or additional software. 7. Your recommended VPS specifications. 8. Your fixed project cost and estimated completion time. 9. Any limitations or prerequisites that need clarification before deployment. Please do not propose a monitoring-only solution that cannot enforce the required USB restrictions. The project will be considered complete only after deployment, testing and documentation."

opportunities.title: Urgent Compact 2-Layer PCB -- 2
opportunities.description: I need a seasoned PCB designer physically based in India who can turn around a compact, two-layer sensor/control board in the next 24-48 hours. You will be working from a complete, verified circuit diagram and parts list; every component footprint is already confirmed, so your focus is purely on smart placement, tight routing, and DRC-clean results. Tools: you may use EasyEDA or KiCad—whichever lets you hit the deadline most efficiently without compromising quality. Key expectations • Neat, manufacturable layout on two layers only • ERC/DRC passed project file (.kicad_pcb or EasyEDA JSON) • Standard Gerber, drill files, and pick-and-place output ready for fabrication • Updated BOM reflecting any reference designator changes The design is small but dense, so an eye for signal integrity, minimal vias, and sensible power/ground handling is essential. Once I share the schematic, I’ll remain available for quick clarifications so we can wrap this up within the target window. Looking forward to seeing how fast and cleanly you can get this board ready for production. "Strict Requirement: Looking for individual embedded hardware/PCB designer based in India only (for prototype component sourcing and shipping to Punjab). No agencies, no generic bot bids. and need someone who can provide - JLCPCB- compatible SMT Files "

opportunities.title: Global Referral Partners for AI Projects
opportunities.description: We are Thorque Software, an AI and software development studio based in Argentina. We build WhatsApp and chat bots, process automations, dashboards and ERP integrations for companies, and we deliver projects remotely to clients anywhere in the world. We are looking for REFERRAL PARTNERS worldwide. A partner is someone who already works in another field and is in regular contact with companies: accountants, consultants, IT technicians, ERP professionals, or salespeople from other industries. WHAT YOU WOULD DO - Spot companies in your network with manual processes or concrete problems. For example, companies that copy data between spreadsheets by hand, answer the same questions all day on WhatsApp, use systems that don't talk to each other, or build reports manually. - Introduce us to the contact. We take care of the discovery meeting, the quote, the closing and the development. - Join the client meeting if you want to. You don't need to know how to sell or code, and you never have to quote prices. WHAT YOU EARN - 10% of the final value of every project closed through your referral. - Projects start at USD 1,000, and many are USD 10,000 or more. - Your commission is paid as soon as the client pays the upfront deposit. CONDITIONS - This is extra income, 100% commission-based, with no fixed salary. - You work independently and flexibly, with no schedules and no minimum targets, so it fits around your current job. - There is no exclusivity and there are no territories. - You get a short training (a video of about 15 minutes) plus support material: real case studies, a company presentation and message templates. REQUIREMENTS - Contacts inside established companies that already have revenue. - Good communication in English or Spanish. - Being able to issue an invoice for your commissions (we agree on the payment method depending on your country). TO APPLY, TELL US 1. What you do today. 2. Your city and country. 3. Which kinds of companies or industries you have contacts in.

opportunities.title: US Civil Engineer: Road & Drainage
opportunities.description: I need an experienced U.S.–based civil engineer to take full ownership of the road, drainage, and utility design for a new project. Your task is to prepare complete, permit-ready plans that cover road layout and grading, a compliant stormwater drainage network, and the water, sewer, and other utility lines that will serve the site. I will supply a topographic survey, preliminary site layout, and any local ordinances already on file. From there, I expect you to determine design criteria, run all necessary calculations, and produce drawings that meet current U.S. codes and standards (AASHTO, local DOT, EPA, etc.) as well as any municipal requirements we identify together. Deliverables • Road alignment, profiles, and grading plan • Stormwater drainage plan with supporting hydrology/hydraulic calculations • Water, sewer, and other utility plans with applicable sizing calculations • CAD (DWG) and print-ready PDF plan set, plus an editable stormwater report Acceptance Criteria • Plans are internally consistent, follow referenced standards, and are ready for submittal without additional drafting. • All calculations are provided in an organized worksheet or report that can be reviewed by the permitting authority. • File formats open cleanly in AutoCAD Civil 3D 2020 (or newer) and PDFs print to scale. If you have recent U.S. roadway and site-utility experience and can deliver stamped or permit-ready civil drawings, let’s discuss schedule and milestones right away.

opportunities.title: Full Brand Identity Design
opportunities.description: I’m refreshing my online presence and need a cohesive brand identity built from the ground up. The core items I want are: • A distinctive, scalable logo supplied in vector (AI/SVG) and high-res PNG formats • A balanced color palette with hex/RGB codes and usage notes • Simple brand-guideline sheet covering clear space, font suggestions, and do/don’t examples • Three ready-to-use social-media post templates sized for Instagram/Facebook, delivered in layered PSD or Canva format Feel free to work in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or another professional design tool you’re comfortable with; what matters is clean, editable source files. My total budget is between ₹500 and ₹1500, so please structure any milestones accordingly and keep licensing free for commercial use. I’ll consider the job complete when I receive the files listed above, the colors render consistently across devices, and the logo scales without loss of quality. If you can start right away and deliver within a few days, that’s perfect—send over a quick outline of your approach along with relevant samples.

opportunities.title: Edición Dinámica para Grabaciones de Pantalla
opportunities.description: Tengo varias grabaciones de pantalla que ya están listas y necesito transformarlas en videos atractivos. El trabajo consiste en añadir textos, zooms y resaltados siguiendo un estilo llamativo y dinámico, con animaciones y colores vivos que capten la atención desde el primer segundo. Qué espero del entregable: • Video final en resolución original, optimizado para YouTube y redes sociales. • Archivo fuente editable (Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve o similar). • Sincronización limpia entre audio, zoom y gráficos superpuestos. • Uso coherente de tipografía y paleta de colores vivos. Para evaluar tu propuesta, me enfoco principalmente en tu experiencia: comparte ejemplos previos donde hayas incorporado zooms, textos animados o efectos de resaltado sobre capturas de pantalla. Si manejas atajos de teclado, transiciones rápidas y conoces buenas prácticas de tutoriales en video, menciónalo: sumarás puntos. Espero tu mensaje con enlace a tu portafolio y el plazo estimado para editar cada video.

opportunities.title: Videos Virales Instagram y TikTok
opportunities.description: Quiero potenciar mis cuentas de Instagram y TikTok con videos cortos y dinámicos. Necesito piezas variadas: desde promociones de producto o servicio y tips educativos rápidos, hasta clips que se suban a las tendencias del momento para enganchar a la audiencia. Objetivos principales • Conseguir más seguidores y mayor alcance. • Generar ventas o leads. • Fortalecer la imagen y la confianza en la marca. Lo que aportaré será únicamente información sobre la marca (valores, tono, datos clave). Por eso requiero que tú investigues, selecciones y utilices imágenes o videos de apoyo libres de derechos que encajen con cada concepto. Qué espero recibir 1. Guion breve o escaleta previa para cada pieza, alineada con los objetivos. 2. Edición completa en formato vertical (Reels/Shorts), con música, transiciones y subtítulos integrados. 3. Archivo final optimizado para subir directamente a ambas plataformas. 4. Sugerencia de copy y hashtags. Busco consistencia estética, ritmo ágil y creatividad para captar la atención en los primeros segundos. Si ya dominas herramientas como CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut o similares y entiendes la cultura TikTok/Instagram, me encantará ver tu propuesta y ejemplos de trabajos previos.

opportunities.title: Logo e Identidad Visual Fitness
opportunities.description: Tengo una web y una app de entrenamiento ya operativas y quiero darles una identidad visual coherente y memorable. Lo que busco: • Un logo principal donde mi nombre o mis iniciales sean el foco, transmitiendo un estilo claramente deportivo y enérgico. • Un símbolo derivado del logo pensado para la app: debe relacionarse con el logo pero funcionar en tamaños reducidos (icono de app, favicon, redes sociales). • Propuesta de paleta de colores y tipografías que refuercen esa personalidad activa y profesional. Quiero que la conexión entre marca personal y app sea evidente: mi nombre como marca principal y un símbolo propio que, al verlos juntos, se perciba como parte de la misma familia gráfica. Entrego cualquier información adicional que necesites sobre la app, la web o mis preferencias. Espero archivos finales en formato vectorial (AI, SVG o similar) más exportaciones PNG/JPG listos para usar.

opportunities.title: Especialista en EPUB y Accesibilidad Digital -- 2
opportunities.description: Busco a un profesional con experiencia técnica avanzada en publicaciones digitales (EPUB) para dos trabajos que pueden contratarse juntos o por separado: Impartir una formación práctica online a mi equipo técnico y de edición, trabajando sobre casos reales. Realizar las modificaciones técnicas necesarias en mis archivos EPUB: maquetar y corregir los problemas técnicos para garantizar una correcta legibilidad de todos sus elementos (tablas, imágenes, texto...) y que superen las validaciones de accesibilidad. La formación se impartirá íntegramente en formato online, y el trabajo técnico sobre los archivos también se podrá realizar en remoto. Busco un especialista del sector editorial o del desarrollo digital que trabaje a fondo con el estándar EPUB y el marco normativo de accesibilidad (Directiva Europea 2019/882, EPUB Accessibility 1.1 y WCAG 2.1 AA). Perfil buscado Busco a alguien que domine la arquitectura interna de un EPUB (HTML5, CSS, metadatos OPF, MathML o LaTeX) y que trabaje habitualmente con herramientas de edición, validación y lectura como Thorium Reader, Calibre, Sigil, Adobe Digital Editions, NVDA, Ace by DAISY y EPUBCheck. Problemas reales y recurrentes que hay que resolver Desajustes de diseño líquido: imágenes que no escalan de forma proporcional con el texto o diagramas cortados en pantalla. Elementos huérfanos entre saltos de página (pies de foto o títulos desvinculados de sus gráficos). Tablas complejas que pierden los encabezados al paginarse. Errores en lectores específicos, como fallos en el buscador de Adobe Digital Editions. Superíndices con numeración corrupta, notas al pie reiniciadas de forma anómala o hipervínculos rotos. Configuración adecuada de metadatos y cumplimiento estricto para superar las validaciones de EPUBCheck y Ace by DAISY sin incidencias. Contacto y propuestas Si te encaja el perfil y te interesa participar, envíame una breve descripción de tu trayectoria con el formato EPUB y la accesibilidad digital, tu disponibilidad de fechas y si te interesa la formación, las modificaciones técnicas o ambas.

Realizar las modificaciones técnicas necesarias en mis archivos EPUB: maquetar y corregir los problemas técnicos para garantizar una correcta legibilidad de todos sus elementos (tablas, imágenes, texto...) y que superen las validaciones de accesibilidad. La formación se impartirá íntegramente en formato online, y el trabajo técnico sobre los archivos también se podrá realizar en remoto. Busco un especialista del sector editorial o del desarrollo digital que trabaje a fondo con el estándar EPUB y el marco normativo de accesibilidad (Directiva Europea 2019/882, EPUB Accessibility 1.1 y WCAG 2.1 AA). Perfil buscado Busco a alguien que domine la arquitectura interna de un EPUB (HTML5, CSS, metadatos OPF, MathML o LaTeX) y que trabaje habitualmente con herramientas de edición, validación y lectura como Thorium Reader, Calibre, Sigil, Adobe Digital Editions, NVDA, Ace by DAISY y EPUBCheck. Problemas reales y recurrentes que hay que resolver Desajustes de diseño líquido: imágenes que no escalan de forma proporcional con el texto o diagramas cortados en pantalla. Elementos huérfanos entre saltos de página (pies de foto o títulos desvinculados de sus gráficos). Tablas complejas que pierden los encabezados al paginarse. Errores en lectores específicos, como fallos en el buscador de Adobe Digital Editions. Superíndices con numeración corrupta, notas al pie reiniciadas de forma anómala o hipervínculos rotos. Configuración adecuada de metadatos y cumplimiento estricto para superar las validaciones de EPUBCheck y Ace by DAISY sin incidencias. Contacto y propuestas Si te encaja el perfil y te interesa participar, envíame una breve descripción de tu trayectoria con el formato EPUB y la accesibilidad digital, tu disponibilidad de fechas y si te interesa la formación, las modificaciones técnicas o ambas."

proposal.body:
¡Hola Solicitante Anuncio #40790640 (Tareas en Español)! 👋 Revisé la solicitud exacta de **"Especialista en EPUB y Accesibilidad Digital -- 2"** y cumplo con los requisitos para iniciar de inmediato.

Realizo **bioconstrucción en guadua, muro tendinoso con botellas y vidrio, todo tipo de cubiertas y estructuras en metal/soldadura, café especial borbón rosado, murales artísticos, modelado 3D en Blender y planos**.

📲 Contacto directo en San Agustín, Huila (Colombia): **+57 322 273 9034**.

blueprint.product_type: 📐 Paquete Express de Planos 2D + Render 3D para Remodeladores y Carpinteros en Colombia
blueprint.deliverable: Plano acotado en PDF/DWG + 3 vistas Render 3D de cómo quedará la cocina, local o remodelación.
blueprint.target_audience: Maestros de obra, remodeladores, carpinterías, fabricantes de cocinas integrales e inmobiliarias en Colombia (Instagram y Facebook).
blueprint.suggested_pricing: COP $220.000 a $650.000 por proyecto (Pago por Nequi / Bancolombia: 50% al iniciar, 50% al entregar).
blueprint.distribution_channels: Escribir por WhatsApp o Instagram DM a 10 cuentas de remodelaciones/cocinas en Colombia cada día ofreciendo el servicio por proyecto.
